messages.敵の火傷が6以上・10以上になるとマッチ威力・コイン威力・ダメージ量が上がる火傷: A Burn attacker whose Clash Power, Coin Power, and damage improve at enemy Burn thresholds of 6 and 10. She cannot increase Burn Count herself and belongs with allies that sustain it.
messages.火傷で強化: 各攻撃スキルは対象の火傷6以上でマッチ威力+1。コイン威力+1の条: **Burn bonuses**: Each attack skill gains +1 Clash Power if the target has at least 6 Burn. The +1 Coin Power condition is 10 or more Burn for S1 All-out War, and 6 or more for S2 Fiery Knifehand and S3 Flame Cleave.
messages.追加ダメージ: S2のⅡコインは対象の火傷6以上で与ダメージ量+20/30/50: **Extra damage**: Coin Ⅱ of S2 deals +20/30/50% damage if the target has at least 6 Burn, and Coin Ⅳ of S3 deals +20/40% at 10 or more.
messages.自前の火傷付与: S1はⅠ・Ⅱコインで火傷1ずつ(Ⅱコイン表面的中時はさらに1): **Her own Burn infliction**: S1 inflicts 1 Burn each with Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ (plus 1 more on Coin Ⅱ Heads Hit), S2 inflicts 2 Burn with Coin Ⅰ, and S3 inflicts 1 Burn each with Coins Ⅰ–Ⅲ. None of her skills increase Burn Count.
messages.バトルパッシブ「火伝」(憤怒×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 火傷の敵を倒すと、火: **Combat passive — Flame Spread (4 Wrath Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Defeating an enemy with Burn inflicts 4 Burn on 1/2 enemies with no Burn or the least Burn, 1/2 times per turn.
messages.サポートパッシブ「伝火」(憤怒×4・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 速度が最も低い味方: **Support passive — Spread Flame (4 Wrath Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: When the 1 slowest ally defeats an enemy with Burn, inflicts 3 Burn on 1/2 random enemies, once per turn.
messages.火傷回数を伸ばせる味方と組み、味方が積んだ火傷が6以上の敵にS2を、10以上の敵: Pair her with allies who can extend Burn Count, and hit enemies with at least 6 Burn from allies with S2, and those with 10 or more with S3. Her own Coins also inflict Burn, so she can push targets up to the thresholds with S1 and S3. Defeating enemies spreads Burn to other enemies through Flame Spread. S1 is Gluttony, so supplying Gluttony resources to Burn teams is another reason to use her.
